verdict.rationale: Qodo's own docs say it can be deployed entirely within your own infrastructure. They include dedicated on-prem guides covering architecture, prerequisites, installation and integrations, plus a deployment-model table listing on-premises and air-gapped options. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted deployment, and detail on which Git providers support on-prem or air-gapped (support is listed per provider, so it may not be uniform).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Deploy Qodo entirely within your own infrastructure.
Deploy Qodo in your own infrastructure with dedicated guides covering architecture, prerequisites, installation, integrations, and optional components.
A reference table of supported deployment models for each Git provider, including multi-tenant, single-tenant, on-premises, and air-gapped options.
This guide covers deploying Qodo in a self-managed infrastructure environment.
